decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith; AB/1194/251 and Design & Access Statement by 'urbaneliving' received 10 September 2009, and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The premises shall not be open for customers outside the following hours:-9am - 6pm Mondays to Fridays;10am to 5.30pm Saturdays; and10am to 4pm Sundays and Bank holidays.

Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7.30am - 6pm Monday to Friday; 8am - 5.30pm on Saturdays nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The access doorways to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level. A unisex toilet that is accessible for a person in a wheelchair shall also be provided within the unit prior to the use commencing and shall be maintained permanently thereafter.
description: Change of use from B1 (office) to A1 (retail)
